messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT detected: KV-cache growth + cont-batching spike affecting Mistral/GQA pipelines across 3 clusters. High tail latency and OOM-ish GC events. auto-pager triggered for oncall.

olivia (oncall): saw the pager. checking dashboards now — big growth in prefix entries starting ~2317890000, continuous batch size jumped from median 4 -> 48 on qwen-multi-chat.

mike (infra): confirmed. node memory pressure in cluster-az3, evictions rising. looks correlated with qwen-16b long-context sessions + prefetch turned on.

sara (runtime): initial hypothesis: continuous batching + aggressive KV prefetch created huge prefix shards that don't get evicted quickly. eviction worker lagging.

olivia (oncall): are there active customer errors? any 5xx?

mike (infra): some elevated 503s for requests routed to those hosts, others hit fallback model. global request success still >95% but latency P95 jumped to 3.2s -> 9.6s for affected routes.

nora (cs): flagged two customers with sustained errors: acct-redwood-fin and acct-voxai. reaching out if we hit longer mitigation.

leo (eng-ml): throwing in model-level nuance: Mistral-GQA flows generate a lot of short-lived prefixes; Qwen-MQA chat uses many unique prefixes due to system messages. both amplify key cardinality when prefetching.

olivia (oncall): recommended immediate mitigations?

sara (runtime): 1) disable KV prefetch globally for the cluster (fast). 2) limit continuous_batch.max_elements to 8 per-request. 3) bump eviction frequency/force-ahead for prefix shards. doing (1) now.

mike (infra): ready to flip network/route changes if needed.

sara (runtime): applying hotfix:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://runtime-internal/api/v1/configs/cluster-az3/hotfix" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $HOTFIX_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"kv_prefetch_enabled": false, "cont_batch_max": 8, "eviction_force": "now"}'
```

sara (runtime): POST returned 202, rolling to nodes. will monitor.

deploy-bot: hotfix rollout started to 16/16 nodes in cluster-az3.

olivia (oncall): metrics after ~2m: prefix entries stopped growing, cont-batch median fell back to 5, P95 latency on affected routes down to 2.1s. memory pressure easing.

mike (infra): started targeted graceful restart of top-3 OOM hosts to get kernel caches cleared — no datasource downtime.

nora (cs): notified acct-redwood-fin and acct-voxai: "we're seeing reduced errors; we'll follow up with root cause and timeline." they acknowledged.

leo (eng-ml): dug into logs: a handful of clients use streaming-ish prompts that append monotonic session ids to system prompts — causes near-infinite prefix churn. suggests we should rate-limit unique prefix keys per session and add heuristic to avoid prefetching for high-cardinality sessions.

olivia (oncall): good catch. assign actions: short-term rollback/hotfix in place; need follow-up engineering ticket for prefix cardinality heuristics + per-model prefetch profiles.

sara (runtime): created temporary feature-flag to re-enable prefetch only when model_prefetch_profile == stable. also added cont_batch cap. committing changes to canary release after we confirm stability.

mike (infra): cluster is stable. will keep eviction_force on for 30m then step down to normal cadence.

deploy-bot: hotfix deployment completed successfully at 2317890458.

pagerduty: incident acknowledged by olivia (oncall).

nora (cs): scheduling customer follow-ups for the two impacted accounts. draft message: "We mitigated a runtime KV-prefetch/cache growth issue causing transient latency and errors. Root cause: prefetch + cont-batching interaction with high-key-cardinality sessions. Hotfix applied, further mitigations planned."

leo (eng-ml): making a list of follow-ups: ["add prefix-cardinality metric", "per-model prefetch profiles", "cont-batch adaptive cap based on kv-load", "eviction priority tuning"]. assigning ownership in internal board.

olivia (oncall): taking incident to resolved state unless anything else pops. final checks: observed 30m stable window, avg errors returned to baseline.

mike (infra): repo of useful debug queries:
```sql
-- find top prefixes by cardinality
select prefix, count(distinct session_id) as uniq_sessions from kv_prefixes
where created_at > now() - interval '10 minutes'
group by prefix order by uniq_sessions desc limit 50;
```

sara (runtime): post-incident follow-up items I'll own: create runbook step: "hotfix-disable-prefetch.sh", add smoke test for cont-batch caps, and instrument evictions with trace IDs.

olivia (oncall): assigning postmortem owner: leo. priority: P1 writeup with timeline + customer impact. nora please include customer comms draft.

nora (cs): will prepare customer-facing note and coordinate with acct teams.

leo (eng-ml): will take PM on remedial work and link to Eval/QA to catch regressions where prefetch + cont-batching produce high cache cardinality.

olivia (oncall): incident status -> RESOLVED (2317890821). thanks team. we'll open a retro doc and link to configs + metrics. :thumbsup:
